missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Голод' is the masculine nominative subject of 'мучает'. 'Сильный' agrees in the masculine, and 'меня' is the accusative object being tormented.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Голод' is the inanimate masculine accusative object of 'чувствую', identical to the nominative. 'После работы' gives a genitive time frame.

missions.phrase: От голода у него кружится голова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of cause. 'От голода' uses the genitive 'голода' after 'от' to express the cause. 'Голова' is the nominative subject of 'кружится'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'От голода' uses the genitive 'голода' after 'от' with the verb 'страдают'. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Голод' is the nominative subject of 'заставил'. 'Его' is the accusative object, and the infinitive 'искать' shows the resulting action.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К голоду' uses the dative 'голоду' after 'к' with the verb 'привык'. A natural pattern for getting used to something hard.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'С голодом' uses the instrumental 'голодом' after 'с' to express the accompanying state. 'Трудно работать' states the difficulty.

missions.phrase: О голоде в войну много пишут.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О голоде' uses the prepositional 'голоде' after 'о' to express the topic. 'В войну' adds a time frame. A common historical theme.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Много' governs the genitive plural 'голодов'. 'В истории' gives the prepositional setting. A reference to recurring famines.
Strategic focus: Nominative in a proverb. 'Голод' is the nominative subject in this fixed saying meaning hunger is no joke. 'Тётка' is the nominative predicate noun negated by 'не'.
